notes: The two coverage bullets, last year's premium and the rental allowance are key facts (the runner drops key_fact proposals). 'If you decide not to renew, you do not need to do anything' is not a separate loop; a model may cite it as a second evidence quote on the decision.

items.title: Pay the Northwind renewal premium
items.quote: To keep your coverage without a gap, pay the renewal premium of $1,284.00 by November 30, 2026.
items.note: 0.80 + 0.05 exact + 0.05 date agrees = 0.90. Amount is the renewal premium, not last year's $1,190.00.

items.title: Confirm annual mileage for each vehicle
items.quote: Please confirm the annual mileage for each vehicle on this policy by November 13, 2026.
items.note: 0.90. The fallback ('we will use last year's mileage') is the consequence, not a second item.

items.title: Decide whether to renew or switch auto insurance
items.quote: You can compare plans or decline renewal by calling 1-800-555-0136.
items.note: Implied decision, no date in the sentence ('by calling' is not a date): 0.55 + 0.05 = 0.60, Maybe. A model that dates it with 'November 30, 2026' from another sentence gets a date miss.
